# Self-Mastery Publications SA – Comprehensive Index
This platform publishes problem-language ranking pages for able South African professionals and sells the physical hardcover of Dianetics: The Modern Science of Mental Health (1950) via Instant EFT with express courier.

## Framing
- Emotional self-improvement and executive performance language only
- Not medical advice, not clinical therapy, not religious instruction
- Able-person audience: still showing up, wants capacity and clarity

## Wave 1 topics
Self mastery for high performers; executive burnout recovery; Johannesburg geo spoke; can't switch off from work; stop snapping / reactivity; successful but empty.

## Fulfillment
Orders dispatch within 24 hours via express courier across major South African metros. Regional bank hubs resolve Instant EFT details by city/suburb.
